notes: Source: s3://noaa-mrms-pds (AWS Open Data), reachable via proxy; all 135 objects downloaded on first pass, gunzipped, sha256 of each .grib2 in sha256sums.txt. QPE-A = RadarOnly_QPE_15M_00.00 (exists for both dates; 108 files valid 2026-08-19T17:15Z..2026-08-20T20:00Z so its summed accumulation period 17:00Z->20:00Z exactly matches QPE-B's 27 hourly files valid 18Z..20Z). Grid: 3500x7000, 0.01 deg, GDAL transform origin (-130.0, 55.0), lat descending from 55.0; CRS is GRIB-native geographic (sphere a=6378160). Units mm; nodata not flagged in metadata - negative values (-3 observed, also -1 per spec) masked as missing before all statistics. No AOI cells were missing in any timestep; no timesteps absent from S3. All-zero AOI fields occur only at the dry start (19th 17:15-19:00Z) and after the event ended (~13Z on the 20th) - consistent between products, not an anomaly. AOI mean = arithmetic mean over the 75x40-cell window (-83.20,39.80,-82.45,40.20); point values are nearest-cell. Pataskala observed_mm is the mean of 4 gauges (136.1/128.0/119.1/109.7). Franklinton has no gauge; modeled totals only. Both products verify low against gauges over this 27-h window (A -24..-46%, B -4..-35%); bias reported, NOT corrected. Observed 'event totals' may include rain outside the hindcast window, which would inflate apparent negative bias. Reader: rasterio (GDAL GRIB driver) opened all files; pygrib fallback not needed.
